description: Source code for the MacroExpander class in the ANGLE project, implementing macro expansion logic for a preprocessor.

classes.name: TokenLexer
classes.description: A lexer that tokenizes a vector of tokens for macro expansion.

classes.name: MacroExpander::ScopedMacroReenabler
classes.description: A RAII class that temporarily disables macro re-enabling during macro argument collection.

classes.name: MacroExpander::MacroContext
classes.description: Represents a macro expansion context with token replacements and current index.

methods.name: lex
methods.description: Retrieves the next token, handling macro contexts and reserve tokens.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Gets the next token from the lexer or macro context.

methods.name: ungetToken
methods.description: Pushes a token back into the token stream or macro context.

methods.name: isNextTokenLeftParen
methods.description: Checks if the next token is a left parenthesis without consuming it.

methods.name: pushMacro
methods.description: Begins macro expansion by pushing a macro's tokens onto the context stack.

methods.name: popMacro
methods.description: Ends macro expansion by popping the current macro context.

methods.name: expandMacro
methods.description: Expands a macro into its token replacements, handling special macros like __LINE__ and __FILE__.

methods.name: collectMacroArgs
methods.description: Collects macro arguments from tokens, handling nested parentheses and validation.

methods.name: replaceMacroParams
methods.description: Replaces macro parameters in macro replacements with actual argument tokens.
